data.name: Sopan Shelar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sopan Shelar has made a big mark in cricket. With 154 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 33, with an average of 13.01 and a quick strike rate of 140.63. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 125 sixes and 106 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 247.3 overs, taking 113 wickets at an economy rate of 9.38. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
